terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-/opt/nvm}"; [[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="${NVM_DIR}/versions/node/v24.19.0/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd autogpt_platform && make run-backend'

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-/opt/nvm}"; [[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="${NVM_DIR}/versions/node/v24.19.0/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd autogpt_platform && make run-frontend'
